'''2020 EGP Hayes Hunter LS Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Hayes Hunter]] at [[2020 Endor Grand Prix]] (Day 1).

* '''Player:''' [[Hayes Hunter]]
* '''Event:''' [[2020 Endor Grand Prix]]
